audit.why: breakdown.difficulty (Tricky 7/10) matches the near-even 50.78% win rate and the early-Swain/mid-skill/late-Alistar shape in content.
Level 2 (Swain's Q+Nevermove punishing the walk-up), level 6 (R tanking the drain but his root still enabling), and late (his poke falling off gold-starved) are all real, kit-grounded spikes.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0].side, phases[1].side, phases[4].side and phases[6].side all disagreed with content win[N] and, in phase[4]'s case, disagreed with its own why-text (side said 'Swain' but the why described an even fight, matching win[4]='Skill'). breakdown.cooldowns had no real cooldown number. missingInteractions also flagged that Ravenous Flock (P) bypasses stacking resistances (percent-based heal), which wasn't stated anywhere.
audit.why: Nevermove (E) is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s by rank — a real number to cite. Content's win[N] array and whys[] already tell a coherent story (Swain L1-2, even mid, Alistar late); the full layer had 4 stale rows.
audit.corrected: Realigned phases[0,1,4,6].side/.rating/.why to content win[N]; added the real Nevermove cooldown to breakdown.cooldowns; added the percent-health heal note to breakdown.early.

edits.before: Trade autos behind the roar sustain — the cow chips politely until level 2 changes religions.
edits.after: Swain's Death's Hand poke outranges your melee walk-up — the cow chips quietly until level 2.

edits.before: W-Q online — the combo is live and every squishy support is now flash-range nervous.
edits.after: His Q-plus-Nevermove root punishes exactly the walk-up your W-Q engage requires.

edits.before: Unbreakable Will online — tower dives become appointments; the cow ignores the counter-CC.
edits.after: Unbreakable Will tanks his drain, but a landed Nevermove still sets up his all-in — stays even.

edits.before: Late Alistar opens and survives: combo the carry, ult the focus, and trample the cleanup.
edits.after: Late favors you: gold-starved Swain support poke falls off while your tank engage scales.

edits.before: - Swain Nevermove: matchup-defining — The root that decides — dodge it and the general farms regret. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep R Unbreakable Will banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Swain's Nevermove (E) is down 12s at rank 1, 10s at rank 5 — dodge it and the general farms regret. The duo's tempo bends around it. - Keep R Unbreakable Will banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.

edits.before: Zone with the threat — the engage you don't use governs more than the one you do.
edits.after: His Ravenous Flock heal scales past armour — HP stacking alone won't stop it.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Sit at max Death's Hand range so poke chips least — walking closer just feeds his Q stacks and his root angle.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: Standing in Death's Hand range to auto-trade just funds his Q stacks — that's a donation with armor.
